LifecycleBlocker.description: One observed original retention owner; it is not a derived index reference.

LifecycleBytes.description: Byte categories never imply filesystem space has been reclaimed.

copied.description: Actual copied extent is known by an export/backup receipt, not retention metadata.

logical.description: Known logical payload extent; absent for unsupported or unbounded metadata.

physical.description: Physical allocated space requires the host resource owner's independent observation.

reclaimed.description: No engine row deletion establishes physical reclaimed space.

LifecycleKind.description:
Each effect has a different original owner. Visibility is a project navigation
operation and physical file collection remains the existing file owner.

oneOf.description: Withdraw a deliberate source-history root; this does not collect its bytes.
Retire run payloads and drive one original bounded result collection page.
Withdraw a study's result retention; runs remain independently explicit.
Release settled run history and drive one original compaction page.
Release settled study history and drive one original compaction page.
Release an unreferenced, noncurrent raw draft version, retaining its summary.
Observe exact evidence ownership. Release requires the original artifact intent.

LifecycleSelectionBody.description: Current owner coordinates, rechecked in the same transaction as release.

draft_generation.description: Current editing-head generation for a raw draft-version release.

generation.description: Original current run/study/draft generation or source sequence.

issuing_store.description: Exact authority; another installation cannot consume this selection.

project_generation.description: Project generation for a raw draft-version release.

revision.description: Immutable source revision, never a newer source substitution.

LifecycleTargetBody.description: Explicit target selection. An explanation never implies consent to release.

kind.description: Original owner/effect, separate from project visibility and file collection.

description: Bounded current observations. The original owner is the final release authority.

blockers.description: Actual observed references, readers or unsettled effects.

blockers_complete.description: False: these bounded observations do not enumerate every original-owner predicate.

bytes.description: Logical, copied, physical and reclaimed extents, with unknown values explicit.

detail_released.description: Raw draft detail was released while the original version summary remains.

requires_original_artifact_intent.description:
Evidence artifacts require release_artifact_intent and collect_artifact with
the exact original immutable intent; an observation key cannot release them.

selection.description: Exact checked selection; retaining this document grants no deletion capability.
